insert into "member" (id, organization_id, user_id, role, app_roles, created_at)
    select gen_random_uuid()::text, o.id, $1, 'owner', $2::jsonb, $3 from "organization" o
    where not exists (select from "member" m where m.organization_id = o.id)
    returning id
update "user" set created_at = timestamptz '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00' where email = 'root@example.com'

insert into "user" (id, name, email, email_verified, role, banned, created_at, updated_at)
  select 'u' || lpad(i::text, 3, '0'), 'User ' || i, 'user' || i || '@example.com', true, 'user', false,
    timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' + (i / 2) * interval '1 microsecond', timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
  from generate_series(1, 150) i
select from "organization" where id = $1 for update

with joined as (
      insert into "member" (id, organization_id, user_id, role, app_roles, created_at)
      select gen_random_uuid()::text, $1, u.id,
        case when 'admin' = any(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(u."role", 'user'), '^\s*\{(.*)\}\s*$', '\1'), '^\s*"?|"?\s*$', '', 'g'), '"?\s*,\s*"?')) then 'owner' else 'member' end,
        case when 'admin' = any(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(u."role", 'user'), '^\s*\{(.*)\}\s*$', '\1'), '^\s*"?|"?\s*$', '', 'g'), '"?\s*,\s*"?')) then to_jsonb($2::text[])
          else coalesce((select jsonb_agg(name order by place) from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(u."role", 'user'), '^\s*\{(.*)\}\s*$', '\1'), '^\s*"?|"?\s*$', '', 'g'), '"?\s*,\s*"?')) with ordinality as held(name, place) where name = any($3::text[])), '[]'::jsonb) end,
        $4
      from "user" u
      where not exists (select from "member" m where m.organization_id = $5 and m.user_id = u.id)
      returning user_id, role, app_roles
    ), demoted as (
      update "user" u set "role" = 'user', "updated_at" = $6 from joined where u.id = joined.user_id and joined.role = 'member'
    )
    select u."email" as email, joined.role, joined.app_roles as "appRoles" from joined
      join "user" u on u.id = joined.user_id
      order by u."created_at", u.id

select count(*)::int as members, count(*) filter (where m.role = 'owner')::int as owners, array_agg(distinct u.role) as global
        from member m join "user" u on u.id = m.user_id where m.organization_id = 'acme'

          else coalesce((select jsonb_agg(name order by place) from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(u."role", 'user'), '^\s*\{(.*)\}\s*$', '\1'), '^\s*"?|"?\s*$', '', 'g'), '"?\s*,\s*"?')) with ordinality as held(name, place) where name = any($3::text[])), '[]'::jsonb) end,
        $4
      from "user" u
      where not exists (select from "member" m where m.organization_id = $5 and m.user_id = u.id)
      returning user_id, role, app_roles
    ), demoted as (
      update "user" u set "role" = 'user', "updated_at" = $6 from joined where u.id = joined.user_id and joined.role = 'member'
    )
    select u."email" as email, joined.role, joined.app_roles as "appRoles" from joined
      join "user" u on u.id = joined.user_id
      order by u."created_at", u.id
